summary: Iteration 4 tested OCR for scanned PDFs, drag-and-drop onto Read a document, and the 9-step guided tour, on backend and frontend. Backend: test_pdf_upload.py was updated and now passes 20/20. The scanned-refused test was replaced with three tests: blank PDF gives 422 'No readable text could be recognized'; a 9-page scanned PDF gives 422 'up to 8'; scanned sample read gives 200. In both 422 cases no source is stored. GET /sample-pdf?scanned=true returns a 2-page PDF with images and no text layer. The scanned upload gave ocr=true, page_count=2, price 12800 (page 2, line 1), Redwood capacity 1/2/4, max 10, advance 10 and customer Harborview, each with page and line. Regression: test_assemble_flow.py and test_extract_summary.py pass 36/36. Frontend (Playwright): the tour opens on its own at organizer login. Back is disabled on step 1. Next/Back/Show me/Do it for me/Finish/Close all work. The step is saved in localStorage, Finish resets it to 0, the tour stays closed after a reload, and demo-tour-open reopens it at step 1. Step 3: $156k, fails on capacity in weeks 1 and 2. Step 4: $168k, passes, 4/4/4. Step 5: links for alder, birch and cedar, all marked shared. Step 6: the change request is logged and the preview opens at 4/4/4 -> 6/4/2 (fail, 2-slot gap). Step 7: Dogwood repair, $172k, passes; the diff shows Alder changed, Birch and Cedar unchanged, Dogwood new. Step 8: current v3 passes. Alder, Birch and Cedar show Awaiting response (links carried over, no responses yet) and Dogwood shows No review link yet. Step 9 Show me highlights decide-summary-link. Step 2 Show me switches to the Read a document tab and highlights the scanned sample button. Scanned PDF in the UI: the sample button fills kind=quote, label and date. Reading took about 6s. The source shows 'scanned PDF, text recognized, 2 page(s)' and the source-ocr warning, and all 13 readings show 'page N, line M'. Drag-and-drop: read-drop-overlay shows during dragover. Dropping a PDF shows read-pdf-chosen with the label set to the filename. Dragleave hides the overlay. Dropping a .docx shows the unsupported-type error in read-errors. Dropping a .txt fills the textarea. No page errors. One bug found and fixed: toasts were still bottom-right and blocked the tour buttons.

minor.issue: A blank or near-blank PDF of up to 8 pages always costs one vision LLM call before the 422. This is expected but adds cost and about 5s of latency. A cheap check (for example, every page renders as one solid colour) could skip OCR for truly blank pages.
As in iteration 3: the object is stored before db.files.insert_one, with no cleanup if a later step fails.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: Toaster was still position='bottom-right', not top-right as claimed. The success toast after 'Do it for me' covered demo-tour-next and demo-tour-run. Playwright click timed out with 'sonner toast intercepts pointer events', and hovering keeps the toast open, so real users would be blocked too. Changed to position='top-right'. Verified: the toast is now at y=24 and the tour card at y=820 (desktop) / 521 (mobile), with no overlap.

issues: The card is 311px tall, about 37% of an 844px viewport. It covers the lower part of the page, for example the 'Create private review link' button on partner cards. main has only pb-24 (96px), so the last content on a page can sit under the card while the tour is open. Suggestion: a collapsible or minimised mode on mobile, or extra bottom padding while the tour is open.
The footer buttons wrap to two rows on mobile: Back alone on the first row, then Show me / Do it for me / Next. It works but looks a bit unbalanced.
Show me uses scrollIntoView with block 'center'. On mobile the highlighted element can end up partly behind the card.
Only the form handles drop. A file dropped just outside the form makes the browser open it and leave the app, losing unsaved input. Consider preventDefault for dragover/drop on window.
A very small dropped PDF shows 'PDF · 0 KB'. Cosmetic.
Quick Next/Back/Show clicks overlap the highlight timers, so the tour-focus class can be removed early by an older timeout. Cosmetic: keep one timer per element and clear the previous one.

action_items: Keep the Toaster at position='top-right' in App.js (tester changed it; it had been left at bottom-right)
Optional: make the tour card smaller or collapsible on mobile, or add bottom padding while it is open
Optional: preventDefault for window-level dragover/drop so a missed drop does not navigate away
Optional: skip OCR for pages that render blank, to avoid an LLM call on empty PDFs
critical_code_review_comments: DemoTour step 6 'Do it for me' posts a new change request every time it is clicked. Running it twice can create a duplicate or fail if one is already in preview. Consider skipping when an open or in-preview change request with the same moves exists.
DemoTour run() does not guard against step.run throwing (for example, r.data.sheet.change_requests missing). act() handles HTTP errors, but a JS exception would be an unhandled promise rejection.
Step 8 'Do it for me' is still shown after the preview is selected. It is a no-op because s.preview is null; it could be hidden or disabled.
ocr.py: the OCR offsets and page_starts matched the typed-PDF reading, and line numbers are correct. The 'treat as untrusted data' system prompt is in place. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows after the toast fix (one HIGH bug found and fixed)

seed_data_creation: Demo visitor sandboxes per run (pdf-<hex>), one test_<hex>@example.com registered user; demo resets used in browser sessions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_pdf_upload.py now makes 3 LLM calls: a blank-PDF OCR, a scanned OCR plus read, and the typed read. It takes about 25s; use -n 0. Each browser_automation call is a new context, so log in each time. The tour opens unless localStorage has 'assemble_tour_closed'. On a fresh login the sheet opens on the draft task; use task-step-intake and then intake-tab-read to reach the Read form. Use the demo-reset-button and demo-reset-confirm buttons for a clean copy.
